text: Champion Swordsmen are chosen from among the Empire's provincial legions. They cut down the Empire's enemies with keen blades, carving a path for the Empire's advance.

Serving as the Emperor's personal guard, this special order—numbering only eight at any given time—answers to no one but the Emperor himself. Its chosen members are not only among the greatest living swordsmen, but also polymaths ceaselessly refining their skill in literature, politics, and even the arts, ensuring they can offer the Emperor the greatest possible service.
Warrior Priests bound by holy oath to the Cult of Sigmar, they cast aside their mortal identities, vowing to fight for the Cult of Sigmar and guard the Empire's faith together.
Knights bound by oath to the Colleges of Magic, they must guard the colleges with their very lives in exchange for the chance to glimpse the secrets of the magic of the Eight Winds.

The Imperial Dragon is the only true dragon within the Empire's borders, its age beyond imagining. It once ruled this world, and now slumbers deep within the Altdorf Zoo. Should it ever awaken, all it deems enemy shall be consumed in flame.

The Order of the Deathly Omen are experts at rooting out heresy, most of its members drawn from the witch hunter fraternities of every province. Each member's own history is enough to leave even the most seasoned bard speechless.

The Legion of a Thousand Men are the mortal incarnation of Sigmar's divine power. They are typically stationed as the inner guard of the palace at Altdorf, but when the Empire has need, Sigmar himself shall guide them upon their own crusade.

The members of the Silent Heaven are chosen from the most devout and gifted witch hunters, upholding the Seven Precepts to ensure they remain fit to pursue Sigmar's pilgrimage until their final hour. The most well-known of these is the Vow of Silence. They are Sigmar's angels sent down to the mortal world, the natural enemy of wicked sorcery, and silent, merciless executioners.

The Ebon Maidens are the armed force under the Cult of Sigmar. These battle nuns, armed to the teeth, possess unmatched combat skill on the battlefield, while also being devout and practiced in prayer. They defeat their enemies through the power of faith and shelter the people of the Empire.

The steam sarcophagi, forged in Nuln, are the crowning achievement of Imperial engineering. Legend holds that within each of these holy war machines rests the soul of a great Imperial hero. Gears and steam drive their mechanical forms, thundering across the battlefield to destroy the unfaithful.

The Order of the Golden Firstborn is composed of honor-driven young nobles of Altdorf. These romantic warriors possess skill as dazzling as their appearance, and a heartfelt sense of glory. They cast aside their noble titles, seeking only to become true heroes of the Empire.

The Arbiter Black Guard are the most devoted followers of Myrmidia, Goddess of War. These secret protectors clad in black armor serve as guardians of her temples, carrying her faith across the length and breadth of the Old World.

The Inner Circle Knights are the most elite warriors among all the Empire's knightly orders. The Grand Master is the core and commander of a knightly order, chosen from among the Inner Circle for their venerable renown. Grand Masters are seasoned commanders, exemplars of knightly virtue, and among the mightiest warriors in the Old World.
These heavily armored foot knights form the backbone of the Empire's forces, forging the Empire's battle lines with keen steel.
The Laurel Knights are drawn from the Inner Circle of the Reiksguard. These proud warriors are unmatched in the charge alongside their loyal demigryphs.

Before the founding of the Brotherhood of the Blood Oath, its members had already fought Khorne's forces countless times. Fewer and fewer survivors emerged from the blood and flame, and those who remained were consumed by both the guilt of losing their comrades and the growing madness wrought by Khorne's influence. They swore an oath in blood, dedicating themselves to the endless war against Chaos.
Huntsmen are the most agile gunmen on the battlefield, typically deployed at the front to harass enemy positions, or relied upon for their keen observation skills to serve as scouts and sentries.

These finely dressed handgunners are drawn from every province of the Empire. Their well-ordered Handgunner Companies can effortlessly wipe out even the most fearsome enemies within their web of fire, and should any foe manage to reach them, these elite soldiers can just as easily cut them down with expert swordplay.
The Ravenwatch lurk through the long night, destroying the undead abominations that hail from the realms of the once-living, lighting the Empire's path with fire.

Mercenaries from every corner gather within the Empire's borders, among them the deadly pavise crossbowmen from the city-states of Tilea, who can be found almost everywhere and have integrated seamlessly into the Empire's armies.
The Wolves of Ulric are the mortal agents of the Wolf God's power. Their fighting spirit shall burn away the winter of Chaos.

'Claws of Ulric' is the name bestowed by Ulric's faithful upon this legendary old wolf. This brave and ferocious beast has spent countless years alongside the cult, believed to be chosen by the White Wolf God himself—the mortal incarnation of the War God, come to save the cult in its hour of need.

The Order of Battle is the elite armed force of the Cult of Sigmar. As candidates for the rank of high Warrior Priest, these devout brothers shall throw themselves into battle without hesitation to defend the faith.
